recentItems.title: Creamline takes care of business vs. Choco Mucho, marches to PVL Finals
recentItems.description:

With the win, the Cool Smashers advance to the Finals for the 16th time, while the Flying Titans are relegated to the bronze medal match.

recentItems.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia, vows to be 'a better CEO'
recentItems.description:
Nvidia employees cheered and chanted Jensen Huang's name as he returned to the company's headquarters in Santa Clara, California, on Monday (November 23), following his reinstatement as chief executive.

Footage shared on social media showed Huang standing with his hand on his heart, looking up at employees gathered across multiple floors of the building. Reuters was able to confirm the location and date of the video from original file metadata. Stairs, railings and flooring of the building also matched with archive imagery.

"I'm gonna be a better CEO the second time," Huang told employees.

Shares of Nvidia, cornerstone of the AI trade, ended 31.5% higher, their biggest daily percentage gain since May 9, 2003. Nvidia had announced Huang's resignation on November 12 after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.

recentItems.title: South Korea issues 'take shelter' warning after Russia aircraft fly near airspace
recentItems.description:
South Korea's Air Force scrambled fighter jets on Tuesday (November 24) and the government issued a "preemptive" warning to take shelter for residents of an island after Russian military planes briefly entered the country's air defense identification zone (ADIZ).

    South Korea's military had tracked "multiple" Russian aircraft as they made the approach and were "on the verge" of entering the airspace over Ulleung island off the east coast, a spokesperson for the Joint Chiefs of Staff said.

    There was no intrusion of South Korea's airspace by the Russian aircraft in the end, the military said.

    The defence ministry will summon the Russian military attache later on Tuesday to "lodge a stern protest," ministry spokesperson Chung Binna said.

    The Russian embassy in Seoul did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

    Russian aircraft have entered South Korea's ADIZ several times in recent months as Moscow does not recognize the designation, but the civil defense warning telling residents to urgently take shelter was rare.

(Editing: Soohyun Jung; Production: Soohyun Jung, Heejung Jung; Writing: Jack Kim)

recentItems.title: WATCH: 'Beaver' supermoon lights up Manila's night sky
recentItems.description:
The year's Beaver Moon lit up the skies over Manila on Tuesday night (November 24), appearing as a spectacular supermoon.

"Supermoon" is the term used to refer to full moons that occur when the moon is at, or very near, its closest point to Earth in its elliptical orbit, a position known as perigee, according to NASA.

The name "Beaver Moon" originates from the time when hunters traditionally set traps for beavers in autumn to secure a supply of warm fur for the winter.

(Production: Adrian Portugal)

recentItems.title: Daga sa coffee shop nag-viral; kapihan pansamantalang nagsara bilang aksyon | TV Patrol
recentItems.description:
Nagpaalala ang Department of Health sa food business operators sa kahalagahan ng malinis at ligtas ng pagkaing ibinebenta sa mga customer. 

Ito'y matapos mag-viral sa social media ang video ng daga sa loob ng isang coffee shop. 

Tumugon naman ang kapihan sa comment section ng uploader at sinabing pansamantalang isinara ang naturang branch at nagsagawa ng paglilinis, inspeksyon, at iba pang hakbang para matiyak ang kaligtasan ng mga customer at empleyado.

Payo ng DOH sa mga consumer na makakakita ng daga sa establisimiyento, agad itong ipaalam sa city o municipal health office o sa lokal na pamahalaan para sa kaukulang inspeksyon at imbestigasyon.

Dagdag ng DOH, dapat may tinatawag na 'vector' o pest control program ang mga food establishment para tiyaking walang daga o iba pang peste sa kanilang lugar.

Nagpapatrol, Jessie Cruzat. TV Patrol, Martes, 24 Nobyembre 2026 .

recentItems.title: 100 testigo balak isalang ng prosekusyon sa paglilitis ni Duterte sa ICC | TV Patrol
recentItems.description:
100 testigo ang inaasahang ipepresenta ng mga taga-usig sa International Criminal Court Trial Chamber III sa paglilitis ni dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte sa kasong crimes against humanity.

Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng ICC na si Orianne Maillet, sa dami ng mga testigong balak isalang ng prosekusyon, inaasahang magtatagal ang paglilitis kay Duterte dahil bukod pa ito sa dami ng ebidensyang ilalatag at iba pang isyung tatalakayin ng korte.

Sa ilalim ng mga patakaran ng ICC, inaasahang mauuna ang prosekusyon sa presentasyon ng ebidensya at testigo bago ang kampo ng mga biktima o common legal representatives for victims at saka naman sasalang ang mga abogado ni Duterte para sa kanyang depensa.

Dagdag ni Maillet, bagamat mapapanood ang paglilitis sa pamamagitan ng livestream at personal na pagpunta sa korte, may mga pagkakataong hindi isasapubliko ang pagkakakilanlan ng mga testigo o kaya naman ay isasara sa publiko ang ilang bahagi ng trial para tiyakin ang kaligtasan ng mga testigo.

TV Patrol, Martes, 24 Nobyembre 2026.
